state.task: Review a small arithmetic helper for correctness and edge cases. It parses an optional integer limit and selects items from a collection. Assess empty input, negative bounds, off-by-one behavior and explain the change. Do not implement anything.

catalog.description: Review invariants and off-by-one risks in integer parsing and collection slicing.
catalog.excerpt:
# invariant-review
Identify the count and ordering invariants before reviewing bounds. Read actual source through normal tools.

catalog.description: Review proposed code changes for correctness, regressions and maintainability.
catalog.excerpt:
# review-patch
Read the changed functions and their callers. Report concrete defects with independent expected behavior. Do not change source. A local receipt should identify the highest risk.

catalog.description: Check tricky input boundaries and invariants for code changes; useful alongside review.
catalog.excerpt:
# boundary-check
Use a behavior table: ordinary input, empty input, large input and malformed input. Read ordinary source bodies before identifying boundaries. Return specific observable outcomes.
